newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Unicer denies interested buying Vidago.
newsitem.headline: Unicer denies interested buying Vidago.

text.p: Portuguese drinks company Unicer denied a report it was interested in buying mineral water company Vidago, Lisbon bourse said in a statement.
"The news reports that said Unicer could be interested in launching a public offer to buy for Vidago were denied," Lisbon bourse said.
Diario Economico newspaper said Unicer was interested in making a counter-offer for Vidago.
Portugal's second biggest retailer Jeronimo Martins on Tuesday formally announced a bid for Vidago, valuing the company at 15.8 billion escudos ($104 million).
On Tuesday Lisbon bourse ended a brief suspension of trade in Unicer shares.
